title: 泌尿科
intro: 本科程序庫涵蓋腎絞痛與尿路結石（體外震波、輸尿管鏡、經皮腎造瘻取石）、阻塞合併感染的腎臟急症、攝護腺肥大與經尿道切除、尿滯留與導尿、攝護腺癌的診斷路徑與治療、膀胱癌與腎癌手術、睪丸扭轉急症、血尿評估、尿道狹窄、尿失禁、Fournier 壞疽、腎移植概念與小兒泌尿。
introEn: This library covers renal colic and stones (ESWL, ureteroscopy, PCNL), the obstructed infected kidney, BPH and TURP, retention and catheterisation, the prostate-cancer diagnostic pathway and treatment, bladder and kidney cancer surgery, testicular torsion, haematuria assessment, urethral stricture, incontinence, Fournier's gangrene, transplant concepts and paediatric urology.

procedures.title: 腎絞痛：影像、止痛與結石治療選擇
procedures.titleEn: Renal colic: imaging, analgesia and choosing stone treatment
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：34 歲男性，凌晨左腰劇痛放射至鼠蹊、嘔吐、血尿。急診主治、放射師與泌尿科值班醫師共同處理。本單元教影像選擇、警訊辨識與體外震波／輸尿管鏡／經皮腎造瘻取石的決策邏輯，不含藥物劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 34-year-old man with severe left loin pain radiating to the groin at 3 a.m., vomiting and haematuria; the ED attending, radiographer and on-call urologist manage him. Teaches imaging choice, red flags and the logic of ESWL versus ureteroscopy versus PCNL, without drug doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stages.title: 典型病史
stages.evidence: 絞痛來去、坐立難安、放射到鼠蹊；腹部軟。
stages.evidenceEn: Colicky pain coming in waves, unable to lie still, radiating to the groin; soft abdomen.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 疑腹膜炎，需緊急外科剖腹探查
choices.en: Peritonitis: urgent surgical exploration

choices.zh: 腎絞痛典型，仍需排除主動脈瘤
choices.en: Classic colic, but exclude an aortic aneurysm

choices.zh: 背部肌肉拉傷，止痛休息即可
choices.en: Back muscle strain: rest and analgesia

stages.reason: 坐立難安是腎絞痛的特徵，腹膜炎病人反而不敢動；50 歲以上首次「腎絞痛」要想主動脈瘤。
stages.reasonEn: Restlessness marks colic while peritonitis keeps patients still; a first episode over 50 should raise aortic aneurysm.
stages.pitfall: 若忽略鑑別：破裂的主動脈瘤被當成結石。
stages.pitfallEn: Unconsidered, a leaking aneurysm is labelled a stone.

stages.title: 尿液與檢驗
stages.evidence: 尿液試紙血尿陽性、無白血球；肌酸酐正常；體溫 37.2°C。
stages.evidenceEn: Dipstick positive for blood, no leucocytes; creatinine normal; 37.2°C.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 血尿陽性即可確診結石，免做影像
choices.en: Positive blood confirms a stone; no imaging needed

choices.zh: 無白血球即排除感染，止痛回家
choices.en: No leucocytes means no infection; analgesia and home

choices.zh: 支持結石；同時檢查感染與腎功能
choices.en: Supports a stone; also check infection and kidney function

stages.reason: 約一到兩成結石病人無血尿；感染徵象與腎功能決定急迫性。
stages.reasonEn: Haematuria is absent in 10-20% of stone patients; infection signs and renal function decide urgency.
stages.pitfall: 若只看血尿：無血尿的阻塞被漏掉。
stages.pitfallEn: Relying on haematuria misses an obstructing stone without it.

stages.title: 影像選擇
stages.evidence: 住院醫師想先安排腹部 X 光。
stages.evidenceEn: The resident wants a plain abdominal film first.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 低劑量非顯影 CT 為成人首選
choices.en: Low-dose non-contrast CT is first line in adults

choices.zh: KUB X 光加超音波即可診斷
choices.en: KUB X-ray plus ultrasound is diagnostic

choices.zh: 顯影劑 CT 才能清楚看到輸尿管
choices.en: Contrast CT is needed to see the ureter

stages.reason: 非顯影 CT 敏感度與特異度最高並提供大小、位置與密度；X 光漏掉尿酸結石。
stages.reasonEn: Non-contrast CT has the highest sensitivity and specificity and gives size, site and density; plain films miss uric acid stones.
stages.pitfall: 若只 X 光：透光結石與其他診斷被漏掉。
stages.pitfallEn: A plain film misses radiolucent stones and alternative diagnoses.

stages.title: CT 判讀
stages.evidence: 左遠端輸尿管 6 mm 結石、輕度腎水腫、密度 1,100 HU。
stages.evidenceEn: A 6 mm distal left ureteric stone, mild hydronephrosis, 1,100 HU.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 6 mm 必會自行排出，免追蹤
choices.en: A 6 mm stone always passes; no follow-up

choices.zh: 超過 5 mm 需立即輸尿管鏡
choices.en: Over 5 mm needs ureteroscopy now

choices.zh: 約半數可排出：藥物輔助並追蹤
choices.en: About half pass: medical expulsive therapy and follow-up

stages.reason: 排出率隨大小與位置變化：<5 mm 多可排出，5–10 mm 遠端約半數，>10 mm 少見。
stages.reasonEn: Passage depends on size and site: under 5 mm mostly pass, 5-10 mm distal about half, over 10 mm rarely.
stages.pitfall: 若不追蹤：靜默阻塞導致腎功能喪失。
stages.pitfallEn: Unfollowed, silent obstruction costs renal function.

stages.title: 止痛
stages.evidence: 病人痛到嘔吐；護理師問止痛選擇。
stages.evidenceEn: He is vomiting with pain; the nurse asks about analgesia.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: NSAID 為第一線，鴉片類備援
choices.en: NSAIDs first line; opioids as rescue

choices.zh: 嗎啡優先，NSAID 會傷腎不用
choices.en: Morphine first; NSAIDs harm the kidney

choices.zh: 確診前不給止痛，以免掩蓋症狀
choices.en: No analgesia before diagnosis to avoid masking

stages.reason: NSAID 止痛效果與鴉片類相當且嘔吐較少；腎功能與消化道風險是禁忌考量。
stages.reasonEn: NSAIDs match opioids for pain with less vomiting; renal function and gastrointestinal risk guide contraindications.
stages.pitfall: 若延遲止痛：不必要的痛苦與再次就診。
stages.pitfallEn: Delayed analgesia means needless suffering and re-attendance.

stages.title: 警訊
stages.evidence: 另一病人：結石合併體溫 38.9°C、心跳 118、白血球 19,000。
stages.evidenceEn: Another patient: stone with 38.9°C, heart rate 118, WBC 19,000.
stages.question: 此時最需警覺的是？
stages.questionEn: What needs the most vigilance now?

choices.zh: 口服抗生素後回家，門診追蹤
choices.en: Oral antibiotics, home and clinic follow-up

choices.zh: 阻塞合併感染：緊急減壓
choices.en: Obstructed and infected: urgent decompression

choices.zh: 先等 CT 正式報告再會診
choices.en: Wait for the formal CT report first

stages.reason: 感染加阻塞是泌尿科急症；其他警訊包括單腎、急性腎損傷、頑固疼痛。
stages.reasonEn: Infection with obstruction is a urological emergency; other red flags are a solitary kidney, acute kidney injury and intractable pain.
stages.pitfall: 若回家：數小時內敗血性休克。
stages.pitfallEn: Sent home, septic shock follows within hours.

stages.title: 藥物輔助排石
stages.evidence: 病人問有沒有藥能幫助排出。
stages.evidenceEn: He asks whether any drug helps passage.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 沒有藥物有效，只能多喝水
choices.en: No drug helps; just drink more

choices.zh: 預防性抗生素可以加速排石
choices.en: Prophylactic antibiotics speed passage

choices.zh: 可考慮甲型阻斷劑輔助排石
choices.en: An alpha-blocker can aid passage

stages.reason: 甲型阻斷劑對較大的遠端結石最有幫助；需告知適應症外使用與副作用。
stages.reasonEn: Alpha-blockers help most for larger distal stones; off-label use and side effects must be explained.
stages.pitfall: 若未告知副作用：姿勢性低血壓跌倒。
stages.pitfallEn: Unwarned, he faints from postural hypotension.

stages.title: 治療選擇
stages.evidence: 4 週後結石未排出、持續疼痛。
stages.evidenceEn: Four weeks on, the stone has not passed and pain persists.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 再觀察 3 個月，等它自行排出
choices.en: Observe three more months to let it pass

choices.zh: 輸尿管鏡或震波，依結石與偏好
choices.en: Ureteroscopy or ESWL by stone factors and preference

choices.zh: 直接做開放式輸尿管切開取石
choices.en: Proceed to open ureterolithotomy

choices.zh: 遠端結石也以經皮腎造瘻為首選
choices.en: PCNL is first choice even for distal stones

stages.reason: 遠端結石以輸尿管鏡清石率最高；高密度（>1,000 HU）與長皮膚結石距離降低震波成功率。
stages.reasonEn: Ureteroscopy clears distal stones best; high density (over 1,000 HU) and long skin-to-stone distance lower ESWL success.
stages.pitfall: 若無限等待：輸尿管狹窄與腎功能喪失。
stages.pitfallEn: Open-ended waiting causes stricture and renal loss.

stages.title: 大結石的選擇
stages.evidence: 另一病人：腎盂 2.5 cm 結石。
stages.evidenceEn: Another patient: a 2.5 cm renal pelvis stone.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 經皮腎造瘻取石最佳
choices.en: PCNL is the best choice

choices.zh: 體外震波數次即可擊碎
choices.en: A few ESWL sessions will break it

choices.zh: 無症狀可觀察，每年追蹤
choices.en: Asymptomatic: observe with yearly imaging

stages.reason: 大於 2 cm 的腎結石震波需多次且殘石率高；PCNL 一次清石率最佳。
stages.reasonEn: Renal stones over 2 cm need multiple ESWL sessions with high residual rates; PCNL clears them best in one sitting.
stages.pitfall: 若選震波：石街（steinstrasse）阻塞輸尿管。
stages.pitfallEn: ESWL here causes a steinstrasse obstructing the ureter.

stages.title: 追蹤
stages.evidence: 病人說不痛了，想取消追蹤。
stages.evidenceEn: He says the pain has gone and wants to cancel follow-up.
stages.question: 這一步的主要理由是？
stages.questionEn: What is the main reason for this step?

choices.zh: 需影像確認，不痛不代表通暢
choices.en: Image to confirm; no pain isn't patency

choices.zh: 不痛就代表結石已排出，可取消
choices.en: No pain means it has passed; cancel

choices.zh: 每三個月 CT 終身追蹤
choices.en: CT every three months for life

stages.reason: 疼痛消失可能是腎臟停止工作；追蹤影像是安全的終點。
stages.reasonEn: Pain can stop because the kidney has stopped working; follow-up imaging is the safe endpoint.
stages.pitfall: 若未確認：靜默阻塞造成腎萎縮。
stages.pitfallEn: Unconfirmed, silent obstruction leads to renal atrophy.

stages.title: 預防與衛教
stages.evidence: 結石分析：草酸鈣。
stages.evidenceEn: Stone analysis: calcium oxalate.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 嚴格限制鈣攝取以減少結石
choices.en: Strictly limit calcium to prevent stones

choices.zh: 草酸鈣與飲食無關，照常即可
choices.en: Oxalate stones are unrelated to diet

choices.zh: 多喝水、正常鈣、減鹽減肉
choices.en: Plenty of fluid, normal calcium, less salt and meat

stages.reason: 低鈣飲食反而增加草酸吸收；飲水量是最有效的單一措施。
stages.reasonEn: Low-calcium diets raise oxalate absorption; fluid intake is the single most effective measure.
stages.pitfall: 若限鈣：復發率上升且骨質流失。
stages.pitfallEn: Calcium restriction raises recurrence and costs bone.

procedures.title: 輸尿管鏡與經皮腎造瘻取石：安全原則
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：34 歲男性遠端輸尿管 6 mm 結石未排出，安排輸尿管鏡；同日另一位 2.5 cm 腎結石病人接受經皮腎造瘻取石。泌尿科主治、麻醉科醫師、刷手護理師與放射師參與。本單元教術前準備、入路安全、損傷辨識與術後敗血症，不含雷射或器械設定；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 34-year-old man with an unpassed 6 mm distal stone for ureteroscopy, and a second patient with a 2.5 cm renal stone for PCNL the same day; the urologist, anaesthetist, scrub nurse and radiographer take part. Teaches preparation, access safety, injury recognition and postoperative sepsis without laser or device settings; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stages.title: 術前尿液
stages.evidence: 術前一週尿液培養：大腸桿菌陽性，病人無症狀。
stages.evidenceEn: Urine culture a week before: E. coli, patient asymptomatic.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 無症狀菌尿不必治療，照常手術
choices.en: Asymptomatic bacteriuria needs no treatment; proceed

choices.zh: 依培養結果術前治療，再排手術
choices.en: Treat per culture first, then operate

choices.zh: 術中再給一劑抗生素就足夠
choices.en: A single intraoperative antibiotic dose is enough

stages.reason: 結石手術前的菌尿是術後敗血症最強的預測因子；培養導向治療是標準。
stages.reasonEn: Bacteriuria before stone surgery is the strongest predictor of postoperative sepsis; culture-directed treatment is standard.
stages.pitfall: 若忽略：術中腎內高壓把細菌推入血流。
stages.pitfallEn: Ignored, intrarenal pressure drives bacteria into the bloodstream.

stages.title: 知情同意
stages.evidence: 病人問輸尿管鏡的風險。
stages.evidenceEn: He asks about the risks of ureteroscopy.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 內視鏡手術沒有傷口，風險極低
choices.en: No incision, so risk is minimal

choices.zh: 只需說明可能殘石與再次手術
choices.en: Mention residual fragments and repeat surgery only

choices.zh: 說明支架、輸尿管損傷與敗血症
choices.en: Explain stent symptoms, ureteric injury and sepsis

stages.reason: 支架相關症狀最常見；輸尿管撕脫雖罕見但災難性，需事先告知。
stages.reasonEn: Stent symptoms are the commonest issue; ureteric avulsion is rare but catastrophic and must be disclosed.
stages.pitfall: 若未提支架：病人以為手術失敗。
stages.pitfallEn: Unwarned about the stent, he believes the operation failed.

stages.title: WHO 核對
stages.evidence: 刷手護理師核對；放射師問透視設備是否需要。
stages.evidenceEn: The scrub nurse checks; the radiographer asks whether fluoroscopy is needed.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 確認側別、抗生素、透視與雷射護目
choices.en: Confirm side, antibiotics, fluoroscopy and laser eyewear

choices.zh: 核對身分即可，側別看影像就會知道
choices.en: Identity is enough; the images show the side

choices.zh: 輸尿管鏡不需透視，可免放射師
choices.en: No fluoroscopy needed for ureteroscopy

stages.reason: 側別錯誤在泌尿科是真實風險；雷射護目與透視準備是團隊安全的一部分。
stages.reasonEn: Wrong-side surgery is a real urological risk; laser eye protection and fluoroscopy readiness are team safety.
stages.pitfall: 若影像不在：對錯邊的輸尿管操作。
stages.pitfallEn: Without the images displayed, the wrong ureter is instrumented.

stages.title: 擺位
stages.evidence: 截石位；病人有髖關節置換。
stages.evidenceEn: Lithotomy; he has a hip replacement.
stages.question: 此時最需警覺的是？
stages.questionEn: What needs the most vigilance now?

choices.zh: 緩慢對稱擺位、限制外展、墊護神經
choices.en: Position slowly and symmetrically, limit abduction, pad nerves

choices.zh: 照常大角度外展雙腿，以利器械操作
choices.en: Abduct widely as usual for instrument access

choices.zh: 髖關節置換與擺位無關，照常
choices.en: A hip replacement doesn't affect positioning

stages.reason: 截石位造成腓神經麻痺與髖脫臼；俯臥 PCNL 需保護眼睛、腹部與臂神經叢。
stages.reasonEn: Lithotomy risks peroneal palsy and hip dislocation; prone PCNL needs eye, abdominal and brachial plexus protection.
stages.pitfall: 若強力外展：人工髖關節脫位。
stages.pitfallEn: Forceful abduction dislocates the prosthetic hip.

stages.title: 安全導線
stages.evidence: 住院醫師想不放安全導線直接上鏡。
stages.evidenceEn: The resident wants to pass the scope without a safety wire.
stages.question: 這一步的主要理由是？
stages.questionEn: What is the main reason for this step?

choices.zh: 經驗足夠可省略導線，節省時間
choices.en: Experienced hands can skip it to save time

choices.zh: 保留通往腎臟的路徑以備放支架
choices.en: It keeps access to the kidney for stenting

choices.zh: 改用鞘管即可取代安全導線
choices.en: An access sheath can replace the safety wire

stages.reason: 損傷或視野喪失時，導線是唯一能確保引流的保障。
stages.reasonEn: When injury or loss of vision occurs, the wire is the only guarantee of drainage.
stages.pitfall: 若無導線：穿孔後無法置放支架，需腎造瘻。
stages.pitfallEn: Without a wire, a perforation cannot be stented and needs a nephrostomy.

stages.title: 碎石中的視野
stages.evidence: 視野模糊、腎盂壓力上升、助手把灌注壓調高。
stages.evidenceEn: The view is cloudy, pelvic pressure rising, and the assistant turns up the irrigation.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 再調高灌注壓，視野就會清楚
choices.en: Raise irrigation further to clear the view

choices.zh: 憑記憶的結石位置繼續發射雷射
choices.en: Keep firing the laser at the remembered position

choices.zh: 暫停並降灌注壓，等視野恢復
choices.en: Pause, lower pressure, wait for the view

stages.reason: 高腎內壓造成腎盂靜脈回流與敗血症；看不清楚就不發射雷射。
stages.reasonEn: High intrarenal pressure causes pyelovenous backflow and sepsis; no laser firing without a clear view.
stages.pitfall: 若盲目發射：輸尿管穿孔。
stages.pitfallEn: Blind firing perforates the ureter.

stages.title: 損傷辨識
stages.evidence: 看到輸尿管外脂肪；導線在管腔外。
stages.evidenceEn: Periureteric fat is visible; the wire lies outside the lumen.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 穿孔：停止，沿導線放支架並結束
choices.en: Perforation: stop, stent over the wire, finish

choices.zh: 穿孔很小無妨，繼續完成碎石
choices.en: A small hole is fine; finish the lithotripsy

choices.zh: 立即改為開放手術直接修補輸尿管
choices.en: Convert to open repair of the ureter now

stages.reason: 穿孔以引流處理即可癒合；持續操作造成尿液外滲與狹窄。
stages.reasonEn: A perforation heals with drainage; persisting causes extravasation and stricture.
stages.pitfall: 若繼續：尿瘤與輸尿管狹窄。
stages.pitfallEn: Continuing produces a urinoma and stricture.

stages.title: 支架決策
stages.evidence: 單純輸尿管鏡、無損傷、碎石完全。
stages.evidenceEn: Uncomplicated ureteroscopy, no injury, complete clearance.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 所有輸尿管鏡都應常規放支架
choices.en: Every ureteroscopy needs a routine stent

choices.zh: 單純無損傷可不放或短期支架
choices.en: Uncomplicated: stentless or a short stent

choices.zh: 放長期支架半年，以防狹窄
choices.en: A six-month stent to prevent stricture

stages.reason: 常規支架增加症狀而無益；損傷、水腫、殘石或單腎時才需要。
stages.reasonEn: Routine stenting adds symptoms without benefit; injury, oedema, fragments or a solitary kidney justify it.
stages.pitfall: 若一律放：不必要的支架症狀與二次移除。
stages.pitfallEn: Routine stents cause needless symptoms and removal procedures.

stages.title: PCNL 入路
stages.evidence: 第二台手術：選擇穿刺腎盞。
stages.evidenceEn: Second case: choosing the calyx to puncture.
stages.question: 這一步的主要理由是？
stages.questionEn: What is the main reason for this step?

choices.zh: 直接穿刺腎盂，路徑最短最快
choices.en: Puncture the pelvis directly: shortest route

choices.zh: 經腎盞漏斗部穿刺，視野較佳
choices.en: Through the infundibulum for a better view

choices.zh: 經腎盞穹窿穿刺，避開肋膈角
choices.en: Through the calyceal fornix, avoiding the pleura

stages.reason: 經穹窿入路避開葉間血管；上盞穿刺需警覺胸膜損傷。
stages.reasonEn: Fornical entry avoids interlobar vessels; upper-pole punctures risk the pleura.
stages.pitfall: 若直接穿腎盂：大出血或腎盂撕裂。
stages.pitfallEn: Direct pelvic puncture bleeds heavily or tears the pelvis.

stages.title: PCNL 出血
stages.evidence: 擴張後大量靜脈出血，視野全紅。
stages.evidenceEn: Heavy venous bleeding after dilatation; the view is entirely red.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 加快速度取完結石，結束後再止血
choices.en: Finish the stones quickly, then deal with bleeding

choices.zh: 置管夾閉、停手術；動脈性則栓塞
choices.en: Clamp a nephrostomy tube and stop; embolise arterial bleeds

choices.zh: 立即開腹探查，必要時腎切除
choices.en: Open exploration now, nephrectomy if needed

stages.reason: 靜脈出血多以夾管壓迫止住；延遲性動脈出血（假性動脈瘤）需血管栓塞。
stages.reasonEn: Venous bleeding usually stops with tube tamponade; delayed arterial bleeding from a pseudoaneurysm needs embolisation.
stages.pitfall: 若繼續：失血性休克。
stages.pitfallEn: Continuing leads to haemorrhagic shock.

stages.title: 恢復室
stages.evidence: 術後 2 小時：寒顫、體溫 39.5°C、血壓 85/50。
stages.evidenceEn: Two hours postoperatively: rigors, 39.5°C, blood pressure 85/50.
stages.question: 此時最需警覺的是？
stages.questionEn: What needs the most vigilance now?

choices.zh: 尿路敗血症：組套並確認引流
choices.en: Urosepsis: sepsis bundle and check drainage

choices.zh: 術後灌注液吸收反應，觀察即可
choices.en: Irrigation absorption reaction; observe

choices.zh: 退燒止痛後持續觀察生命徵象
choices.en: Antipyretics and analgesia, then observe

stages.reason: 結石手術後的敗血症進展極快；引流不通暢是首先要排除的來源。
stages.reasonEn: Sepsis after stone surgery escalates fast; blocked drainage is the first source to exclude.
stages.pitfall: 若觀察：數小時內多重器官衰竭。
stages.pitfallEn: Observed, multi-organ failure follows within hours.

stages.title: 支架移除與交班
stages.evidence: 出院時支架仍在。
stages.evidenceEn: He goes home with a stent in place.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 病歷有寫到即可，不需另外登記
choices.en: Noting it in the record is enough

choices.zh: 口頭告知病人，請他自己記得
choices.en: Tell him verbally to remember it

choices.zh: 登錄支架、給移除日期與支架卡
choices.en: Register it with a removal date and stent card

stages.reason: 遺忘的支架會結痂、斷裂並造成腎功能喪失；登記制度是系統性防護。
stages.reasonEn: A forgotten stent encrusts, fractures and destroys renal function; a register is the systemic safeguard.
stages.pitfall: 若遺忘：一年後嚴重結痂需多次手術。
stages.pitfallEn: Forgotten, it encrusts within a year and needs multiple operations.

procedures.title: 阻塞合併感染的腎臟：緊急減壓
procedures.titleEn: The obstructed infected kidney: emergency decompression
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：67 歲糖尿病女性，右腰痛兩天、發燒 39.4°C、血壓 88/52、意識略混亂；CT 顯示 8 mm 近端輸尿管結石合併腎水腫。急診主治、泌尿科、介入放射科與加護團隊參與。本單元教辨識、減壓方式選擇與時序，不含藥物劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 67-year-old diabetic woman with two days of right loin pain, 39.4°C, blood pressure 88/52 and mild confusion; CT shows an 8 mm proximal ureteric stone with hydronephrosis. The ED attending, urology, interventional radiology and ICU take part. Teaches recognition, choice of decompression and timing without drug doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stages.title: 第一眼
stages.evidence: 發燒、低血壓、意識混亂、腰痛；qSOFA 3。
stages.evidenceEn: Fever, hypotension, confusion, loin pain; qSOFA 3.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 單純腎盂腎炎，口服抗生素
choices.en: Simple pyelonephritis: oral antibiotics

choices.zh: 敗血性休克疑阻塞：緊急影像
choices.en: Septic shock, likely obstruction: urgent imaging

choices.zh: 先等尿液培養結果，再決定用藥
choices.en: Wait for the urine culture before treating

stages.reason: 阻塞加感染是「泌尿科的腹膜炎」；抗生素無法穿透阻塞的腎臟。
stages.reasonEn: Obstruction with infection is the peritonitis of urology; antibiotics cannot penetrate an obstructed kidney.
stages.pitfall: 若當單純腎盂腎炎：夜間休克惡化。
stages.pitfallEn: Treated as simple pyelonephritis, shock deepens overnight.

stages.title: 復甦
stages.evidence: 護理師問順序。
stages.evidenceEn: The nurse asks about sequence.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 先送 CT 確認阻塞，再給抗生素
choices.en: CT to confirm obstruction before antibiotics

choices.zh: 先減壓，抗生素等引流後再給
choices.en: Decompress first; antibiotics after drainage

choices.zh: 培養後一小時內抗生素並聯絡泌尿
choices.en: Cultures, antibiotics within an hour, call urology

stages.reason: 培養不應延遲抗生素超過數分鐘；減壓與抗生素並行而非先後。
stages.reasonEn: Cultures must not delay antibiotics more than minutes; decompression and antibiotics run in parallel.
stages.pitfall: 若等待：每小時延遲增加死亡率。
stages.pitfallEn: Every hour of delay raises mortality.

stages.title: 影像
stages.evidence: CT：8 mm 近端結石、中度腎水腫、腎周脂肪浸潤、腎實質灌注不均。
stages.evidenceEn: CT: 8 mm proximal stone, moderate hydronephrosis, perinephric stranding, heterogeneous enhancement.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 阻塞性腎盂腎炎，支持緊急減壓
choices.en: Obstructed pyelonephritis: urgent decompression

choices.zh: 輕度腎水腫常見，抗生素即可
choices.en: Mild hydronephrosis is common; antibiotics suffice

choices.zh: 灌注不均疑腎腫瘤，需 MRI
choices.en: Patchy enhancement suggests tumour: MRI

stages.reason: 腎水腫加全身感染徵象即足夠；不需等更多檢查。
stages.reasonEn: Hydronephrosis with systemic infection is enough; no further tests are needed.
stages.pitfall: 若等更多檢查：減壓延後數小時。
stages.pitfallEn: More tests delay decompression by hours.

stages.title: 急迫性
stages.evidence: 泌尿科說手術室凌晨 4 點才有空，介入放射科現在可以。
stages.evidenceEn: Urology says theatre is free at 4 a.m.; interventional radiology is available now.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 支架較安全，等凌晨手術室再放
choices.en: Stents are safer; wait for theatre at 4 a.m.

choices.zh: 用最快可得方式減壓，兩者相當
choices.en: Fastest available route; both work equally

choices.zh: 抗生素先撐著，明早再減壓
choices.en: Antibiotics will hold; decompress tomorrow

stages.reason: 減壓方式的選擇取決於可得性、凝血狀態與解剖；時間比方式重要。
stages.reasonEn: Choice of route depends on availability, coagulation and anatomy; time matters more than method.
stages.pitfall: 若等待：休克不可逆。
stages.pitfallEn: Waiting makes the shock irreversible.

stages.title: 支架或腎造瘻
stages.evidence: 另一病人：相同情況但血小板 40,000、INR 2.5。
stages.evidenceEn: Another patient: same picture but platelets 40,000 and INR 2.5.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 膿尿嚴重，仍以腎造瘻優先
choices.en: Nephrostomy first despite the clotting

choices.zh: 先矯正凝血到正常再減壓
choices.en: Correct clotting fully before decompressing

choices.zh: 凝血異常時逆行支架較安全
choices.en: With coagulopathy a retrograde stent is safer

stages.reason: 腎造瘻穿刺在凝血異常者出血風險高；支架在嚴重阻塞或膿尿時引流可能不足。
stages.reasonEn: Nephrostomy puncture bleeds in coagulopathy; a stent may drain poorly with severe obstruction or pus.
stages.pitfall: 若凝血異常者穿刺：腎周血腫。
stages.pitfallEn: Puncturing a coagulopathic patient causes a perinephric haematoma.

stages.title: 知情同意
stages.evidence: 病人意識混亂，家屬在場。
stages.evidenceEn: She is confused; her family is present.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 等她意識恢復清醒後再簽同意書
choices.en: Wait until she is lucid to sign

choices.zh: 依最佳利益緊急處置並告知家屬
choices.en: Act in her best interests and inform the family

choices.zh: 由家屬代簽，反對就不能做
choices.en: Family signs; if they object, don't proceed

stages.reason: 無能力病人的救命處置依最佳利益原則；家屬提供資訊而非否決權。
stages.reasonEn: Life-saving treatment for a patient lacking capacity follows best interests; the family informs but does not veto.
stages.pitfall: 若等待清醒：她可能再也不清醒。
stages.pitfallEn: Waiting for lucidity may mean she never regains it.

stages.title: 減壓後
stages.evidence: 腎造瘻流出膿尿 300 mL；血壓短暫回升後又降。
stages.evidenceEn: The nephrostomy drains 300 mL of pus; pressure rises briefly then falls again.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 減壓失敗，需再放一條腎造瘻
choices.en: Decompression failed: place a second nephrostomy

choices.zh: 腎臟已化膿壞死，立即腎切除
choices.en: The kidney is destroyed: nephrectomy now

choices.zh: 短暫惡化常見，續復甦並查引流
choices.en: Transient worsening is common; resuscitate, check the tube

stages.reason: 引流釋放內毒素可能短暫惡化；管路阻塞是可矯正的原因。
stages.reasonEn: Draining releases endotoxin and may worsen things briefly; a blocked tube is a correctable cause.
stages.pitfall: 若判定失敗：不必要的腎切除。
stages.pitfallEn: Judged a failure, she loses a kidney needlessly.

stages.title: 加護照護
stages.evidence: 乳酸 5、需升壓劑、少尿。
stages.evidenceEn: Lactate 5, vasopressors needed, oliguric.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 轉加護並依培養調整抗生素
choices.en: ICU with culture-guided antibiotics

choices.zh: 已減壓，轉回一般病房觀察
choices.en: Decompressed, so ward observation

choices.zh: 血壓回升後即可轉口服出院
choices.en: Oral switch and discharge once pressure recovers

stages.reason: 敗血性休克需加護監測；培養結果讓抗生素降階。
stages.reasonEn: Septic shock needs ICU monitoring; cultures allow de-escalation.
stages.pitfall: 若病房觀察：夜間心跳停止。
stages.pitfallEn: On the ward, she arrests overnight.

stages.title: 確定性治療
stages.evidence: 第 3 天：退燒、升壓劑停用；住院醫師想明天取石。
stages.evidenceEn: Day 3: afebrile, off vasopressors; the resident wants to remove the stone tomorrow.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 退燒了，明天就做輸尿管鏡取石
choices.en: Fever has settled: ureteroscopy tomorrow

choices.zh: 保留腎造瘻管長期引流即可
choices.en: Leave the nephrostomy long term instead

choices.zh: 感染完全控制後才確定性治療
choices.en: Definitive treatment only once infection is cleared

stages.reason: 急性期操作感染的腎臟會再次敗血症；引流管在此期間維持。
stages.reasonEn: Instrumenting an infected kidney in the acute phase re-triggers sepsis; the drain stays meanwhile.
stages.pitfall: 若過早手術：第二次敗血性休克。
stages.pitfallEn: Operating too early causes a second septic shock.

stages.title: 交班與出院
stages.evidence: 病人帶著腎造瘻管出院等待手術。
stages.evidenceEn: She goes home with a nephrostomy awaiting surgery.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 管路照護、發燒警訊與手術日期
choices.en: Tube care, fever red flags and surgery date

choices.zh: 管路由居家護理處理，不需衛教
choices.en: Home nurses handle it; no teaching needed

choices.zh: 管路不適時可自行在家拔除
choices.en: She may pull it out at home if it bothers her

stages.reason: 腎造瘻管移位或阻塞會讓感染復發；明確日期避免病人失聯。
stages.reasonEn: A displaced or blocked tube brings the infection back; a fixed date prevents loss to follow-up.
stages.pitfall: 若無衛教：管路阻塞後再度敗血症。
stages.pitfallEn: Uneducated, a blocked tube brings sepsis back.

procedures.title: 急性尿滯留與導尿：困難導尿升級與恥骨上導尿
procedures.titleEn: Acute urinary retention and catheterisation: difficult catheter escalation and suprapubic access
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：74 歲男性，12 小時無法排尿、下腹劇痛；近日感冒服用綜合感冒藥。急診護理師、住院醫師與泌尿科值班醫師參與。本單元教評估、導尿原則、升級路徑與導尿後照護，不含導管規格設定；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 74-year-old man unable to void for 12 hours with severe suprapubic pain, recently taking a cold remedy; the ED nurse, resident and on-call urologist take part. Teaches assessment, catheter principles, the escalation pathway and post-catheter care without catheter specifications; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stages.title: 誘因
stages.evidence: 服用含抗組織胺與偽麻黃鹼的感冒藥、便秘三天、長期夜尿。
stages.evidenceEn: Taking an antihistamine-pseudoephedrine cold remedy, constipated for three days, long-standing nocturia.
stages.question: 這一步的主要理由是？
stages.questionEn: What is the main reason for this step?

choices.zh: 處理可逆誘因：藥物與便秘
choices.en: Treat reversible triggers: drugs and constipation

choices.zh: 誘因與滯留無關，只需導尿
choices.en: Triggers don't matter; just catheterise

choices.zh: 夜尿多年，直接排攝護腺手術
choices.en: Years of nocturia: book prostate surgery

stages.reason: 抗膽鹼與甲型促效藥物是常見誘因；處理誘因決定能否成功拔管。
stages.reasonEn: Anticholinergic and alpha-agonist drugs are common triggers; addressing them decides whether the catheter can come out.
stages.pitfall: 若忽略：拔管試驗必然失敗。
stages.pitfallEn: Ignored, the trial without catheter is bound to fail.

stages.title: 膀胱掃描
stages.evidence: 下腹濁音、觸痛；掃描 900 mL；肛門指檢攝護腺腫大光滑。
stages.evidenceEn: Suprapubic dullness and tenderness; scan 900 mL; smooth enlarged prostate on rectal examination.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 急性尿滯留確立，需立即引流
choices.en: Acute retention confirmed: drain now

choices.zh: 先熱敷下腹，再等他自行排尿
choices.en: Warm compress and wait for voiding

choices.zh: 給甲型阻斷劑後再等兩小時
choices.en: Alpha-blocker and wait two hours

stages.reason: 掃描確認容積並排除無尿；疼痛性滯留需立即引流。
stages.reasonEn: The scan confirms volume and excludes anuria; painful retention needs immediate drainage.
stages.pitfall: 若等待：膀胱過度擴張與上尿路損傷。
stages.pitfallEn: Waiting over-distends the bladder and damages the upper tracts.

stages.title: 導尿準備
stages.evidence: 住院醫師準備直接插管。
stages.evidenceEn: The resident is about to catheterise.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 急性滯留情況緊急，直接插入即可
choices.en: Urgent, so just insert it

choices.zh: 同意、查過敏、無菌與足量潤滑膠
choices.en: Consent, check allergies, sterile kit, plenty of gel

choices.zh: 先給靜脈鎮靜讓括約肌放鬆
choices.en: IV sedation first to relax the sphincter

stages.reason: 凝膠潤滑與時間讓括約肌放鬆；過敏史在導尿前確認。
stages.reasonEn: Gel lubrication and time relax the sphincter; allergies are confirmed before catheterisation.
stages.pitfall: 若無潤滑：尿道黏膜撕裂與假通道。
stages.pitfallEn: Without lubrication the mucosa tears and a false passage forms.

stages.title: 無菌原則
stages.evidence: 插入時遇到阻力，住院醫師開始用力。
stages.evidenceEn: Resistance is met and the resident starts pushing.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 穩定施力推過攝護腺段即可
choices.en: Push steadily through the prostatic urethra

choices.zh: 換成更細的導管再用力推進
choices.en: Switch to a thinner catheter and push

choices.zh: 遇阻力即停，調整角度不強推
choices.en: Stop at resistance, adjust the angle, never force

stages.reason: 強推造成假通道與出血，讓後續導尿更困難。
stages.reasonEn: Force creates a false passage and bleeding, making every later attempt harder.
stages.pitfall: 若強推：假通道、尿道狹窄。
stages.pitfallEn: Forced, a false passage and later stricture result.

stages.title: 升級路徑
stages.evidence: 兩次嘗試失敗、尿道口出血。
stages.evidenceEn: Two failed attempts and blood at the meatus.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 換人用更大力氣再試第三次
choices.en: Someone else tries a third time, harder

choices.zh: 停止並升級：彎頭導管或泌尿科
choices.en: Stop and escalate: coudé catheter or urology

choices.zh: 停止嘗試，給止痛等明天門診
choices.en: Stop, give analgesia, wait for clinic tomorrow

stages.reason: 較大口徑導管較不易彎折進入假通道；兩次失敗後應升級而非重複。
stages.reasonEn: A larger catheter kinks less into a false passage; after two failures escalate rather than repeat.
stages.pitfall: 若重複嘗試：尿道嚴重損傷。
stages.pitfallEn: Repeated attempts cause severe urethral injury.

stages.title: 恥骨上導尿
stages.evidence: 泌尿科決定恥骨上導尿；病人有下腹正中手術疤痕。
stages.evidenceEn: Urology chooses suprapubic access; he has a lower midline scar.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 依體表標記在恥骨上兩指盲目穿刺
choices.en: Blind puncture two fingers above the pubis

choices.zh: 有疤痕即絕對禁忌，無法進行
choices.en: A scar is an absolute contraindication

choices.zh: 超音波導引，確認膀胱充盈無腸道
choices.en: Ultrasound-guided, full bladder, no bowel in the way

stages.reason: 腸道損傷是恥骨上導尿最嚴重的併發症；影像導引與可觸及的膀胱是前提。
stages.reasonEn: Bowel injury is the most serious complication; imaging guidance and a palpable bladder are prerequisites.
stages.pitfall: 若盲穿：小腸穿孔。
stages.pitfallEn: A blind puncture perforates small bowel.

stages.title: 導尿後
stages.evidence: 引流 1,400 mL；之後每小時 400 mL；尿液淡紅。
stages.evidenceEn: 1,400 mL drained, then 400 mL an hour; urine pale pink.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 夾管間歇引流以防血尿與低血壓
choices.en: Clamp intermittently to prevent haematuria and hypotension

choices.zh: 尿已排空，立即拔除導尿管
choices.en: Bladder empty: remove the catheter now

choices.zh: 監測阻塞後利尿與電解質
choices.en: Watch for post-obstructive diuresis and electrolytes

stages.reason: 夾管無證據益處；大量利尿者需補液與電解質監測。
stages.reasonEn: Clamping has no proven benefit; heavy diuresis needs fluid and electrolyte monitoring.
stages.pitfall: 若忽略利尿：脫水與低血壓。
stages.pitfallEn: Unmonitored diuresis causes dehydration and hypotension.

stages.title: 病因處理
stages.evidence: 住院醫師問接下來的藥物。
stages.evidenceEn: The resident asks what to prescribe.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 甲型阻斷劑、治便秘、停誘發藥
choices.en: Alpha-blocker, treat constipation, stop culprit drugs

choices.zh: 給一週預防性抗生素即可拔管
choices.en: A week of prophylactic antibiotics, then remove

choices.zh: 不需藥物，導尿一週後直接拔
choices.en: No drugs; remove after a week

stages.reason: 甲型阻斷劑提高拔管成功率；誘因未除則復發。
stages.reasonEn: Alpha-blockers raise the success of catheter removal; recurrence follows if triggers persist.
stages.pitfall: 若未處理：再次滯留回急診。
stages.pitfallEn: Untreated, he returns in retention.

stages.title: 拔管試驗
stages.evidence: 拔管後 6 小時排尿 150 mL，掃描殘尿 450 mL。
stages.evidenceEn: Six hours after removal he voids 150 mL; residual 450 mL.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 已可自解 150 mL，算成功
choices.en: Voided 150 mL, so it's a success

choices.zh: 殘尿會慢慢下降，先出院觀察
choices.en: Residual will fall; discharge and watch

choices.zh: 失敗：重新導尿並轉泌尿科
choices.en: Failed: re-catheterise and refer to urology

stages.reason: 拔管失敗或大量殘尿代表需要確定性治療；反覆嘗試只延長痛苦。
stages.reasonEn: Failure or large residuals mean definitive treatment is needed; repeated trials prolong misery.
stages.pitfall: 若當成功：隔天再度滯留。
stages.pitfallEn: Called a success, he is back in retention tomorrow.

stages.title: 出院與交班
stages.evidence: 病人帶導管出院等待門診。
stages.evidenceEn: He goes home with a catheter awaiting clinic.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 導管照護很簡單，不需要特別衛教
choices.en: Catheters are simple; no teaching needed

choices.zh: 導管照護、警訊、門診與社區護理
choices.en: Catheter care, red flags, clinic and community nursing

choices.zh: 覺得可以排尿了就自行拔管
choices.en: Pull it out himself when he feels ready

stages.reason: 帶管出院的病人需要明確的照護計畫與回診路徑。
stages.reasonEn: A patient discharged with a catheter needs a clear care plan and return route.
stages.pitfall: 若無交班：導管阻塞在家無人處理。
stages.pitfallEn: Without handover, a blocked catheter at home goes unmanaged.

procedures.title: 攝護腺肥大的藥物治療階梯
procedures.titleEn: The medical treatment ladder for benign prostatic enlargement
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：66 歲男性，夜尿三次、尿流變細、排尿不盡感一年。泌尿科門診主治與藥師參與。本單元教評估、藥物選擇原則與何時轉向手術，不含劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 66-year-old man with nocturia three times a night, a weak stream and incomplete emptying for a year, seen by the urology clinic attending and pharmacist. Teaches assessment, principles of drug choice and when to move to surgery, without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 經尿道攝護腺切除與 TUR 症候群辨識
procedures.titleEn: Transurethral resection of the prostate and TUR syndrome recognition
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：71 歲男性，藥物治療失敗合併反覆尿滯留，安排經尿道攝護腺切除。泌尿科主治、麻醉科醫師、刷手護理師與恢復室護理師參與。本單元教同意、麻醉選擇、解剖標誌、併發症辨識，不含電切設定或灌注參數；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 71-year-old man with failed medical therapy and recurrent retention scheduled for TURP; the urologist, anaesthetist, scrub nurse and recovery nurse take part. Teaches consent, anaesthetic choice, landmarks and complication recognition without resection or irrigation settings; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 血尿評估路徑與膀胱鏡
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：63 歲吸菸男性，無痛性肉眼血尿一次，服用抗凝劑；家醫說「應該是抗凝劑造成」。泌尿科門診主治與內視鏡護理師參與。本單元教轉診標準、檢查順序與膀胱鏡判讀；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 63-year-old smoker with one episode of painless visible haematuria on anticoagulants; the GP attributed it to the drug. The urology attending and endoscopy nurse take part. Teaches referral criteria, investigation sequence and cystoscopy interpretation; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 經尿道膀胱腫瘤切除與膀胱內灌注治療
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：63 歲男性，左側壁 2 cm 乳突狀腫瘤，安排經尿道膀胱腫瘤切除。泌尿科主治、麻醉科醫師、刷手護理師與病理科參與。本單元教切除品質、閉孔神經反射、灌注治療原則與風險分層，不含器械或藥物設定；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 63-year-old man with a 2 cm papillary tumour on the left lateral wall scheduled for TURBT; the urologist, anaesthetist, scrub nurse and pathologist take part. Teaches resection quality, the obturator reflex, intravesical therapy principles and risk stratification without device or drug settings; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 急性腎盂腎炎與腎膿瘍
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：45 歲糖尿病女性，發燒、右腰痛、嘔吐三天；住院治療 72 小時後仍發燒。病房主治、放射科醫師與感染科參與。本單元教診斷、培養、影像時機與膿瘍處理，不含抗生素劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 45-year-old diabetic woman with fever, right loin pain and vomiting for three days, still febrile 72 hours into admission; the ward attending, radiologist and infectious diseases team take part. Teaches diagnosis, cultures, timing of imaging and abscess management without antibiotic doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 導尿管相關泌尿道感染與病房導管照護
procedures.titleEn: Catheter-associated urinary tract infection and ward catheter care
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：82 歲女性，髖骨折術後第 6 天仍留置導尿管，今日混亂、低燒；護理師送了尿液培養。病房主治、感染管制護理師與住院醫師參與。本單元教導管必要性、診斷陷阱與處理原則，不含抗生素劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 82-year-old woman still catheterised on day 6 after hip fracture surgery, now confused with a low-grade fever; the nurse has sent a urine culture. The ward attending, infection-control nurse and resident take part. Teaches catheter necessity, diagnostic pitfalls and management principles without antibiotic doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 攝護腺癌診斷路徑：PSA、多參數 MRI、切片與 Gleason
procedures.titleEn: Prostate cancer diagnostic pathway: PSA, multiparametric MRI, biopsy and Gleason
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：61 歲男性，健檢 PSA 6.8 ng/mL，無症狀，父親有攝護腺癌。泌尿科門診主治、放射科醫師與病理科參與。本單元教 PSA 判讀、影像優先策略、切片途徑與分級；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 61-year-old asymptomatic man with a screening PSA of 6.8 ng/mL and a father with prostate cancer; the urology attending, radiologist and pathologist take part. Teaches PSA interpretation, the imaging-first strategy, biopsy route and grading; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 攝護腺癌治療選擇：積極監測、根除性攝護腺切除或放射治療
procedures.titleEn: Prostate cancer treatment choices: active surveillance, radical prostatectomy or radiotherapy
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：61 歲男性，ISUP 2、PSA 6.8、cT2a，在門診與泌尿科主治、放射腫瘤科醫師與癌症個管師討論治療。本單元教各選項的適應症、副作用與共同決策；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 61-year-old man with ISUP 2, PSA 6.8, cT2a disease discussing treatment with the urologist, radiation oncologist and cancer nurse. Teaches indications, side effects and shared decision-making for each option; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 腎腫瘤：Bosniak、腎臟部分或根除性切除
procedures.titleEn: Renal mass: Bosniak, partial or radical nephrectomy
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：57 歲女性，因腹痛做 CT 意外發現右腎 3.5 公分強化腫瘤。泌尿科主治、放射科醫師、麻醉科醫師與刷手護理師參與。本單元教影像判讀、術式選擇、術中安全與併發症辨識，不含器械設定；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 57-year-old woman with an incidental 3.5 cm enhancing right renal mass on CT for abdominal pain; the urologist, radiologist, anaesthetist and scrub nurse take part. Teaches imaging interpretation, choice of operation, intraoperative safety and complication recognition without device settings; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 睪丸扭轉：時間窗與急診探查
procedures.titleEn: Testicular torsion: the time window and emergency exploration
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：15 歲男孩，凌晨 2 點突發左側陰囊劇痛、噁心嘔吐，到院 3 小時。急診主治、泌尿科值班、麻醉科醫師與家長參與。本單元教辨識、不延誤的決策、同意與探查原則；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 15-year-old boy with sudden severe left scrotal pain at 2 a.m., nausea and vomiting, arriving three hours later; the ED attending, on-call urologist, anaesthetist and parents take part. Teaches recognition, decisions without delay, consent and exploration principles; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 睪丸癌：腫瘤標記、腹股溝睪丸切除與分期
procedures.titleEn: Testicular cancer: tumour markers, inguinal orchidectomy and staging
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：27 歲男性，無痛性右睪丸腫塊兩個月。泌尿科主治、放射科醫師、腫瘤科與生殖醫學團隊參與。本單元教評估順序、手術原則、分期與追蹤；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 27-year-old man with a painless right testicular mass for two months; the urologist, radiologist, oncologist and fertility team take part. Teaches the assessment sequence, operative principles, staging and follow-up; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 副睪睪丸炎：鑑別、病因與處置
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：28 歲男性，右陰囊疼痛腫脹三天漸進、排尿灼熱、低燒。急診主治與泌尿科門診參與。本單元教與扭轉的鑑別、依年齡的病因、檢查與追蹤，不含抗生素劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 28-year-old man with three days of gradually worsening right scrotal pain and swelling, dysuria and low-grade fever; the ED attending and urology clinic take part. Teaches differentiation from torsion, age-based aetiology, tests and follow-up without antibiotic doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 尿道狹窄：評估、內切開的限制與尿道成形概念
procedures.titleEn: Urethral stricture: assessment, limits of urethrotomy and urethroplasty concepts
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：42 歲男性，尿流變細兩年、尿柱分叉，20 歲時曾有騎跨傷。泌尿科主治、放射師與重建泌尿科醫師參與。本單元教影像判讀、術式選擇邏輯與尿滯留時的安全處置；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 42-year-old man with two years of a weak spraying stream and a straddle injury at 20; the urologist, radiographer and reconstructive urologist take part. Teaches imaging interpretation, the logic of procedure choice and safe handling of retention; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 尿失禁：壓力型、急迫型與尿路動力學
procedures.titleEn: Urinary incontinence: stress, urgency and urodynamics
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：54 歲女性，咳嗽漏尿五年，近一年急尿頻尿加劇，三次陰道生產。泌尿科門診主治、尿控物理治療師與尿路動力學技術員參與。本單元教分型、保守優先、藥物原則與手術選項；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 54-year-old woman with five years of leakage on coughing and worsening urgency over the past year, three vaginal deliveries; the urology attending, continence physiotherapist and urodynamics technician take part. Teaches typing, conservative-first care, drug principles and surgical options; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: Fournier 壞疽：辨識、嚴重度與緊急清創
procedures.titleEn: Fournier's gangrene: recognition, severity and emergency debridement
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：58 歲糖尿病男性，陰囊腫痛兩天、發燒、今日出現暗紫斑與捻發音，血壓 90/55。急診主治、泌尿科、大腸直腸外科、麻醉科與加護團隊參與。本單元教辨識、嚴重度評估、清創原則與再探查，不含抗生素劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 58-year-old diabetic man with two days of painful scrotal swelling, fever, and today dusky patches with crepitus, blood pressure 90/55; the ED attending, urology, colorectal surgery, anaesthesia and ICU take part. Teaches recognition, severity assessment, debridement principles and relook without antibiotic doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 醫源性輸尿管損傷：術中與延遲辨識、修補原則
procedures.titleEn: Iatrogenic ureteric injury: intraoperative and delayed recognition, repair principles
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：48 歲女性，腹腔鏡子宮切除術中婦科醫師發現骨盆積液疑為尿液，緊急會診泌尿科；另一位病人術後第 7 天才以腰痛與陰道漏尿表現。婦科、泌尿科主治、放射科醫師參與。本單元教辨識、分級與依位置時機的修補邏輯；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 48-year-old woman undergoing laparoscopic hysterectomy when the gynaecologist sees fluid in the pelvis suspicious for urine and calls urology; another patient presents on day 7 with loin pain and vaginal leakage. Gynaecology, urology and radiology take part. Teaches recognition, grading and repair logic by site and timing; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 腎臟移植：捐贈者評估與外科概念
procedures.titleEn: Kidney transplantation: donor assessment and surgical concepts
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：46 歲男性末期腎病，妹妹願意活體捐腎。移植外科主治、腎臟科、移植協調師、麻醉科醫師與加護團隊參與。本單元教捐贈者評估、手術原則與術後早期併發症辨識，不含免疫抑制劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 46-year-old man with end-stage kidney disease whose sister offers a living donation; the transplant surgeon, nephrologist, coordinator, anaesthetist and ICU team take part. Teaches donor assessment, operative principles and early complication recognition without immunosuppressant doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stations.zh: 免疫抑制與感染預防概念

procedures.title: 輸精管結紮與包皮環切：諮詢與原則
procedures.titleEn: Vasectomy and circumcision: counselling and principles
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：門診一上午：36 歲已有兩名子女的男性要求結紮；另一位 52 歲糖尿病男性反覆龜頭炎與病理性包莖；還有急診一位嵌頓包莖。泌尿科主治與門診護理師參與。本單元教適應症、諮詢要點與併發症辨識；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: a clinic morning with a 36-year-old father of two requesting vasectomy, a 52-year-old diabetic with recurrent balanitis and pathological phimosis, and an ED patient with paraphimosis; the urologist and clinic nurse take part. Teaches indications, counselling points and complication recognition; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 小兒腎盂輸尿管交接處阻塞：產前水腎到腎盂成形
procedures.titleEn: Paediatric ureteropelvic junction obstruction: antenatal hydronephrosis to pyeloplasty
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：足月男嬰，產前超音波左腎盂前後徑 18 mm。小兒泌尿科主治、小兒放射科與核醫團隊參與。本單元教產後評估時機、分級、腎功能檢查與手術適應症；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: term boy with antenatal left renal pelvis anteroposterior diameter 18 mm; the paediatric urologist, paediatric radiologist and nuclear medicine team take part. Teaches timing of postnatal assessment, grading, functional testing and surgical indications; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 隱睪症：評估時機與睪丸固定
procedures.titleEn: Undescended testis: timing of assessment and orchidopexy
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：9 個月男嬰，兒科醫師發現右側陰囊空虛轉診。小兒泌尿科主治、門診護理師與家長參與。本單元教檢查技巧、時機、影像的限制與諮詢；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
